title: Triage Report
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of failure-triager. Classifies a run failure by error class (derived deterministically from the stack trace by failure_triage.py) and records the raw trace plus a remediation hint. The error_class is machine-derived, never set by hand.

condition_id.description: The experiment condition that produced this failure.

from_sandbox_ref.description: Optional reference to the sandbox_report that surfaced this failure.

error_class.description: Machine-derived error class from failure_triage.classify_trace(). Never set by hand — must be the output of the deterministic classifier.

stack_trace_excerpt.description: The raw stack trace or error output (or a representative excerpt) from the failed run.

remediation_hint.description: Suggested next debugging step based on the error_class.

notes.description: Any additional context from the failure-triager agent.
